static-spa.recommended_path: DigitalOcean Spaces + Spaces CDN. Drop the build output (dist/, out/, build/) into a private Space and serve via CDN endpoint with custom domain.
caveats: Cache invalidation on Spaces CDN is per-path — bust cache via filename hashes in the build.
Use signed URLs for any non-public assets.

nextjs.recommended_path: App Platform with the auto-detected Next.js buildpack (Node), OR a Droplet + PM2 / Docker for full Node compatibility. Static export goes to Spaces+CDN.
caveats: App Platform supports Next.js but consult the runtime version pin.
ISR / on-demand revalidate works on App Platform; ensure the data source is reachable from the app's region.
next/image runs natively in Node; no special adapter needed.

astro.recommended_path: Spaces+CDN for static output. App Platform with Node adapter for SSR.
caveats: If using Astro DB (libSQL), it's external; not a managed DO product.

sveltekit.recommended_path: App Platform with @sveltejs/adapter-node. Static-only builds go to Spaces+CDN.
caveats: Form actions are POST-heavy — verify rate limits / WAF in front (Cloudflare DNS recommended for WAF/DNSSEC).

remix.recommended_path: App Platform with the Remix Express adapter, OR Docker on a Droplet.

nuxt.recommended_path: App Platform with `nuxt build` + Node adapter; Nitro auto-detects.

vite-spa.recommended_path: Spaces+CDN. Pure static, no SSR needed.

express.recommended_path: App Platform (Node service component) for low-effort, OR Droplet + PM2 / Docker if you need long-lived TCP, native modules, or non-HTTP workloads.
caveats: App Platform has no SSH access; if you need cron, use the App Platform job component or move to a Droplet.
Sessions in memory survive only one instance; use Managed Redis for shared sessions.

fastify.recommended_path: Same as Express — App Platform or Droplet + Docker.

nestjs.recommended_path: App Platform Node service or DOKS for a microservice mesh. NestJS DI works as-is.
caveats: Microservices via TCP transports work on Droplets / DOKS; App Platform is HTTP-only between components.
TypeORM works against Managed Postgres / MySQL with sslmode=require.

hono.recommended_path: App Platform Node service or Functions (for ultra-light handlers). DOKS if scaling out.

wordpress.recommended_path: Droplet (or 1-Click WordPress Droplet) + Managed MySQL + Spaces for media. Or App Platform with the WordPress preset.
caveats: wp-admin / xmlrpc.php / wp-cron.php should be IP-allowlisted via Cloud Firewall.
Use Spaces with the WP Offload Media plugin for /uploads.

laravel.recommended_path: App Platform PHP service component, OR Droplet + nginx + php-fpm + Managed Postgres/MySQL. Queue workers run as App Platform job components or as supervisord on the Droplet.
caveats: Laravel queue workers need a long-lived process — App Platform 'Worker' component handles this.
Storage::disk('do') points at Spaces.

rails.recommended_path: App Platform Rails buildpack (recent versions detected automatically), OR Droplet + Puma + nginx + Managed Postgres.
caveats: ActionCable (WebSockets) works fine on App Platform with Redis for the cable adapter (Managed Redis).
Sidekiq / ActiveJob use App Platform Worker component or supervisord on a Droplet.

django.recommended_path: App Platform Python service (gunicorn) + Managed Postgres. Daphne/uvicorn for ASGI / Channels.
caveats: Channels (WebSockets) needs Redis for the channel layer — use Managed Redis.
Celery workers run as App Platform Worker component or on a Droplet.

flask.recommended_path: App Platform Python service (gunicorn) + Managed Postgres / Redis. Functions for tiny handlers.

spring-boot.recommended_path: Droplet + systemd or DOKS. App Platform supports Java but JVM tuning is more flexible on a Droplet.
caveats: Heap sizing: pick a Droplet/Pod size with at least 2x your -Xmx.
Use Managed Postgres / MySQL with sslmode=require in spring.datasource.url.

hugo.recommended_path: Spaces+CDN. App Platform with the Hugo build preset also works.

jekyll.recommended_path: Spaces+CDN. App Platform with the Jekyll build preset also works.

media-processing-heavy.recommended_path: Droplet + queue (Managed Redis + Sidekiq/Celery) for the workers. Spaces for input/output objects. Avoid App Platform — long-running CPU jobs hit limits.

long-running-compute.recommended_path: Droplet or DOKS (Job resource). Functions are 15min-bounded.

websocket-heavy.recommended_path: App Platform supports WebSocket services. For sticky-session backends, use a Load Balancer with sticky_sessions in front of Droplets.
caveats: App Platform terminates HTTPS at the edge; the upstream is HTTP — no special config needed for WSS.

mysql-app.recommended_path: Managed MySQL cluster + private VPC + trusted-source firewall (droplet-tag or k8s-cluster).
caveats: sslmode=REQUIRED on the client side.
Connection pooling: Managed MySQL includes ProxySQL; configure pool size to match your app concurrency.

postgres-app.recommended_path: Managed Postgres cluster + private VPC + trusted-source firewall + connection pool.
caveats: sslmode=require (or verify-full with the CA cert) on the client side.
Use the read-replica connection string for reporting workloads.

mongodb-app.recommended_path: Managed MongoDB cluster + private VPC + trusted-source firewall.
caveats: tls=true required on the connection string.
Replica set names are auto-managed; do not hard-code.

redis-app.recommended_path: Managed Redis (Valkey) cluster + private VPC + trusted-source firewall.
caveats: rediss:// scheme required; password comes from the connection string.
Eviction policy defaults to allkeys-lru — tune for your use case.

s3-storage.recommended_path: Spaces — S3-compatible API. Migrate via `aws s3 sync s3://<src> s3://<dst> --endpoint-url=https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com` or `rclone sync s3:bucket spaces:bucket`. Add a Spaces CDN endpoint for public reads.
caveats: Spaces lacks some S3 features (lifecycle classes beyond Standard, S3 Select, Object Lock parity).
CORS rules use the same XML format as S3.
